v2.ref: npm astro 7.0.6 (CVE-2026-59729 fix: renderHTMLElement also guarded)

flag.placement: planted by compose entrypoint from $PCB_FLAG (environment, not app code)
flag.detect: the injected attribute name embeds the flag; the SSR HTML output is echoed back by the server, containing the flag only when the attribute name is emitted unescaped

provenance.notes: CVE-2026-54298 (fixed 6.4.6): SSR spreadAttributes passes object keys to addAttribute which interpolates the key into HTML without escaping. The fix added INVALID_ATTR_NAME_CHAR (/[\s"'>/=]/) to addAttribute. Residual: renderHTMLElement() in runtime/server/render/dom.ts has its own inline attribute loop that does not go through addAttribute, so spread-prop keys on native-HTMLElement-subclass components are still interpolated unescaped -> CVE-2026-59729, fixed 7.0.6 by adding the same guard. PoC calls the real SSR functions: /seed = addAttribute('v', 'x" data-pcb="<FLAG>'), /residual = renderHTMLElement(result, HTMLElement-subclass, {[key]:'v'}, {}) with a simulated DOM global (HTMLElement/customElements) as required by the render path. The flag token is echoed when the attribute name survives unescaped. Built 2026-08-01.
